claim.quote: Here, we carry out the first joint analysis of data sets from NOvA and T2K, the two currently operating long-baseline neutrino oscillation experiments (hundreds of kilometers of neutrino travel distance), taking advantage of our complementary experimental designs and setting new constraints on several neutrino sector parameters.

date.note: Published as Nature 646, 818-824 (2025); posted to arXiv the same day (2510.19888).

key_value_text.note: Recorded as key_value_text (not a Quantity) because the ontology's `energy` dimension has no eV² (mass-squared-difference) unit; this mirrors the existing convention in result:nova-oscillation-parameters-2022.
key_value_text.quote: This analysis provides new precision on the Δm²₃₂ mass difference, finding 2.43+0.04/-0.03 (-2.48+0.03/-0.04)×10⁻³ eV² in the normal (inverted) ordering, as well as a 3σ interval on δᶜᵖ of [-1.38π, 0.30π] ([-0.92π, -0.04π]) in the normal (inverted) ordering.
key_value_text.value: |Δm²₃₂| = 2.43(+0.04/-0.03)×10⁻³ eV² (normal ordering) or -2.48(+0.03/-0.04)×10⁻³ eV² (inverted ordering); 3σ interval on δ_CP of [-1.38π, 0.30π] (normal) / [-0.92π, -0.04π] (inverted)

name: Joint neutrino oscillation analysis from the T2K and NOvA experiments

summary.plain: NOvA and T2K, the two currently operating long-baseline neutrino oscillation experiments, combined their data for the first time. The paper reports new precision on the larger neutrino mass difference, which it says is currently the smallest experimental uncertainty on that quantity, and no strong preference for either ordering of the neutrino masses.
summary.technical: First joint three-flavor oscillation analysis of NOvA and T2K data sets, taking advantage of the experiments' complementary designs (the νμ→νe oscillation probability depends on both δ_CP and the mass ordering, which must be teased apart). Reports |Δm²₃₂| = 2.43 +0.04/−0.03 (normal ordering) or −2.48 +0.03/−0.04 (inverted ordering) ×10⁻³ eV², and a 3σ interval on δ_CP of [−1.38π, 0.30π] (normal) / [−0.92π, −0.04π] (inverted). The data show no strong preference for either mass ordering.

title: Joint neutrino oscillation analysis from the T2K and NOvA experiments
why_it_matters: The paper says this is currently the smallest experimental uncertainty on |Δm²₃₂|, and that if the inverted ordering were assumed true within the three-flavor mixing paradigm its results would provide evidence of CP symmetry violation in the lepton sector.
